oracle: bash, running the : builtin under set -x, which parses and expands but runs nothing
excluded: command substitution, which the oracle would have to execute to measure it
arithmetic expansion, whose value the shell computes instead of reading it from the line
an arithmetic command, whose words the shell evaluates instead of running them
process substitution, which the oracle would have to execute to measure it
parameter expansion, named or special, whose argv depends on runtime state no gate can have
locale-specific translation, whose word the shell reads from a catalog and an environment no gate can have
brace expansion, whose argv depends on a comma this corpus never spells
tilde expansion and pathname globbing, whose argv depends on the filesystem
a conditional expression, whose bracket is the character pathname globbing is already excluded for
pipelines, traced from separate processes in no fixed order, and the || an always-succeeding verb never reaches
background commands, whose trace the shell writes from a process of their own
a co-process, which the shell runs asynchronously and traces from a process of its own
file-descriptor-prefixed redirection, a divergence of its own outside these five
a here-string or here-document, whose text the shell hands the command on stdin and not in the argv this corpus compares
an assignment in front of the command, which the shell traces on a line of its own rather than as a word of the command
a compound command whose branches and iterations the shell picks at run time, so no one trace shows every command it may run
a function definition, whose body the shell traces only when the function is called
the time reserved word, whose report bash writes to the stream that carries the trace
a backslash before an ordinary character inside double quotes, a divergence of its own outside these five
bytes above U+007F, which bash writes raw under a locale this corpus does not fix
